rationale: Price is recovering off the session low of $87.40 with the last five 1-minute candles showing a clear staircase of higher lows and higher closes, volume spiking on the most recent up-move, and price now trading above both the session VWAP ($88.57) and the 9-EMA ($88.76), suggesting short-term buying pressure. However, the fundamental backdrop is heavily negative (earnings miss, guidance cut, Sell rating), the stock gapped down ~2% and has already fallen sharply from prior-day levels, and the bounce may simply be a dead-cat relief move — hence small size and modest confidence. Invalidation is set just below the VWAP/EMA cluster at $88.50 to limit downside if the recovery fails.
